fn apply_all(xs : List(Json), ts : List(Live), names : List(String)) : (List(Live), List(String)) =
  match xs of
    Nil => (ts, names)
    Cons(c, rest) => let (nt, n) = change(c, ts) in apply_all(rest, nt, append(names, [n]))

new.name: command_mode
new.source:
fn command_mode(input : Json) : Json =
  fields(input, ["database", "commands"])
  let db = map(validate_table, arr(getfield(input, "database")))
  demand(unique(map(\(t) -> t.name, db)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  var ts := map(make_live, db)
  var vs : List(View) := []
  var rev := 0
  var out := []
  let commands = arr(getfield(input, "commands"))
  demand(length(commands) <= 200, "INVALID_COMMAND")
  for c in sof(commands) do
    let (nt, nv, reply, advances) = handle command(c, db, ts, vs, rev) with
      never reject(code) => (ts, vs, error_response(code), false)
      return x => x
    ts := nt
    vs := nv
    rev := if advances then rev + 1 else rev
    out := append(out, [if op_failed(reply) then reply else JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", reply)])])
  JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", JObj([("results", JArr(out))]))])

new.name: command_shape
new.source:
fn command_shape(c : Json) : Unit =
  let op = text(getfield(c, "op"))
  if op == "insert" || op == "update" then
    fields(c, ["op", "table", "id", "row"])
    demand(value_type(getfield(c, "id")) == "int" && integer(getfield(c, "id")) > 0 && integer(getfield(c, "id")) <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
    let ignored = text(getfield(c, "table")) in
    let ignored2 = arr(getfield(c, "row")) in ()
  elif op == "delete" then
    fields(c, ["op", "table", "id"])
    demand(value_type(getfield(c, "id")) == "int" && integer(getfield(c, "id")) > 0 && integer(getfield(c, "id")) <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")
    let ignored = text(getfield(c, "table")) in ()
  else
    reject("INVALID_COMMAND")
    ()

fn row_delete(rs : List(List(Json)), ids : List(Int), id : Int) : List(List(Json)) =
  match (rs, ids) of
    (Cons(old, rest), Cons(i, more)) => if i == id then row_delete(rest, more, id) else Cons(old, row_delete(rest, more, id))
    _ => []

  match (rs, ids) of
    (Cons(old, rest), Cons(i, more)) => Cons(if i == id then row else old, row_replace(rest, more, id, row))
    _ => []
